items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: So, he was good friends with Lee and also I was good friends with Danny, you know.

ctx.x: Took men out of Sydney's band? Who's Sydney? Sydney Desby.

I see. Yeah, I believe he took one of the, Herbert Hall out of that band, a saxophone player. And, uh, he had a band, well, he can, he can hear you going all around. Well, he came to me, and, uh, told me about the deal. Well, I was kind of a little sick then, and my wife then was working as a waitress at the Pelican, and I was working up there on that story. And, uh, I had an offer to Sydney Desby to go on the boat, see. The season on the boat opens up around, I think around about April and May. So, I thought…

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I had recommended, which they all liked it, Danny Barker. Yeah. That's how Danny Barker got in there.

ctx.x: Picked him up, that's why he was actually on the session. Yeah. So it wasn't Albert Martin on the session? No,

no, no. He, he, he was already out of town in Texas. Yeah. So, um, when they tell him it come time for the boat to leave, well, I had told him to put my notice in it, and I had recommended, which they all liked it, Danny Barker. Yeah. That's how Danny Barker got in there. That was right after the recording, was it? Yeah, shortly after the recording, yeah. Mm-hmm. And, um, I don't know, on the record, they used Rennie Hall, but I don't know, Rennie might have played, like, when I have, when I was out of town after…
because I was satisfied going on the boat. But it was you on all, all, all the records then? Oh, yeah,
